newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: De Boer Unigro 96 pro-forma net NLG 90.1m.
newsitem.headline: De Boer Unigro 96 pro-forma net NLG 90.1m.

text.p: Supermarkets group De Boer Winkelbedrijven NV and wholesaler Unigro said on Tuesday their pro-forma net profits for 1996 amounted to 90.1 million guilders, or 8.48 guilders per share.
The two signed a merger agreement on May 2, which goes before shareholders for approval on May 28 and is retroactive to January 1, 1997.
"The pro-forma accounts show a combined net turnover for 1996 of 6.4 billion guilders. The net result amounts to 90.1 million guilders," the two companies said in a merger statement.
They said the pro-forma net result per share was based on 10.6 million shares outstanding -- including the shares to be issued under the merger agreement, but excluding the warrants.

The merger will be effected by means of a share swap, with all existing shares in Unigro being transferred to De Boer in exchange for 6.05 million new De Boer shares plus one million warrants, resulting in an initial total of 10.6 million De Boer Unigro shares outstanding.
After the exercise of the warrants the amount of shares outstanding will increase to around 11.7 million, De Boer and Unigro said.
They said they would apply for the new shares to be listed on the Amsterdam Stock Exchange.
